title: [review] provisioning.py:520: Seed storage conditional but s
description: After calling create_br_session() on line 514, the session is immediately retrieved with get() and conditionally updated. The session was just created so it must exist - this should assert or raise rather than silently skip storing the seed, which would cause later ACK verification to fail.
close_reason: Fixed: Replaced silent conditional seed storage with RuntimeError when session is missing after create_br_session(). Since the session is stored in _sessions during create_br_session(), its absence after creation indicates a programming error. Silently skipping would cause cryptic ACK verification failures later.
